name: LineTextureModeEnum
description: Enumeration of line texture mode values for LineRenderer.

staticFields.label: Stretch
staticFields.description: Stretch: texture is stretched along the entire line.

staticFields.label: Tile
staticFields.description: Tile: texture is tiled along the line.

staticFields.label: DistributePerSegment
staticFields.description: DistributePerSegment: texture is distributed per segment.

staticFields.label: RepeatPerSegment
staticFields.description: RepeatPerSegment: texture is repeated per segment.
